scope: unfiltered descriptive metadata capacity only; no method gate or throughput claim

image_identity.split_rule: sort names, rank%8==0 test; all other ranks train

coordinate_domains.stored_XY: original COLMAP pixel coordinates; never sampled into an image
coordinate_domains.future_note: Native array-index principal coordinate needs separate alignment to native ndc2Pix (scaled boundary principal minus 0.5); not done here.

training_observation_depth.formula: z = official qvec2rotmat(qvec)[2] dot original XYZ + tvec[2]; no pose fit/renormalization

training_camera_pair_shared_tracks.definition: All points; one contribution per unique known training-image pair in its raw track; no geometric/error/depth/ROI filtering

limitations: Sparse SfM tracks are not dense or absolute free-space certificates.
Tracks have selection bias and incomplete visibility; no unocclusion guarantee.
Positive reconstructed observation z is a consistency descriptor, not a background witness.
No pixel, descriptor, GT mask, feature extraction, render, pruning, training, or fitting.
Counts >=2/3/4/6 are descriptions, never retrofitted method thresholds.
